pla-01.prompt: Edit the provided AAC family-tree image. Preserve every person, clothing, family connection, gray/red/blue frame and red arrow exactly, preserving the flat 2D illustration style. Change ONLY overall framing: scale the ENTIRE diagram down to about 80% of its current size, centered within a larger pure white square canvas, adding a generous white border on ALL FOUR sides. The ENTIRE TOP edge of grandparents' rounded frame must be visible and at least 80 pixels away from canvas top. The bottom blue child frame must also have at least 80 pixels white margin. Every line, arrow and frame completely inside image. No crop, no added figures, no changed relationships, no writing, letters, numbers, labels or watermarks. This is an UNCLE diagram: top grandparents -> two middle adult brothers; left brother -> bottom blue child; red target is middle RIGHT uncle. Preserve exactly.
